- **Intro:** Mission Telecom Mechanic — In-situ Removal, Reassembly & Dynamic Tolerance Reset SOP for Peacekeeping Mobile Satellite Earth Station & Field Power Shelter Wear Components — System Isolation, RF Mute and LOTO Verification: Residual DC bus voltage ≤ 50 VDC after 300 s discharge; 400 VAC bus phase-to-phase 0 VAC; phase-to-earth 0 VAC; shelter frame eart…
- **Key tolerance:** Residual DC bus voltage ≤ 50 VDC after 300 s discharge; 400 VAC bus phase-to-phase 0 VAC; phase-to-earth 0 VAC; shelter frame earth continuity ≤ 0.5 Ω.
- **Standards:** `Act 2015`, `AS/NZS 3000:2018`, `AS/NZS 3760:2010`, `AS/NZS 2772.1:2016`
